title: Refresh the stale component, not just the page
when: An upgrade succeeded but hooks, dashboard or installed project instructions remain old
need: Distinguish installed CLI, server, resident hook process, relay and tracked project layer. Follow the component-specific status/refresh result; a webpage reload does not replace its serving process. Every public install, reinstall and upgrade restarts and dry-evaluates the installed hook evaluator before readiness. Recover through yoke hook resident restart and the named evaluator log; phase timing is never printed in chat.
surface: Installer readiness and named recovery; project orientation and component status own other stale layers.
